mgmt_bio.text: He holds a PhD in molecular biology and has worked for Roche in various leadership positions since 2003, having studied genetics in Salzburg, Austria, before completing his doctorate at New York University in 2003. His Roche career included serving as General Manager of Roche Diagnostics Germany from 2013 to 2017, Global Head of Diagnostics Centralized and Point of Care Solutions in Rotkreuz from 2018 to 2019, CEO of Roche Diagnostics from 2019 to 2022, and ad interim CEO of Roche Pharmaceuticals in early 2023. The Board appointed him to succeed Severin Schwan, who moved to the chairmanship.

citations.title: Roche shareholders back full slate of proposals, approve record dividend increase

sentences.text: Under Thomas Schinecker, chief executive since March 2023, Roche grew 2025 sales 7% at constant rates to CHF 61.5bn and lifted core operating profit 13%, while ten candidates entered Phase III and twelve late-stage studies read out positively.

Capital allocation has leaned to long-term capacity, including a planned $50bn US investment over five years, alongside CHF 3.1bn of acquisitions and CHF 8.4bn of dividends against CHF 11.8bn free cash flow in 2025; the proposed CHF 9.80 dividend marked a 39th consecutive increase at a 50.4% payout.

citations.title: Roche H1 Results: 6% Growth, Exchange-Rate Adjusted

sentences.text: Roche Holding AG grew first-half 2026 sales 6% at constant rates to CHF 30.4 billion, with core operating profit up 10% and the core operating margin widening 1.7 points to 39.0%.

sentences.quote: The top five growth drivers - Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo and Vabysmo - achieved total sales of CHF 11.0 billion, an increase of 12% at CER
sentences.text: Growth is broad-based, led by Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo and Vabysmo, which together reached CHF 11.0 billion, up 12% at constant rates.

sentences.quote: The Diagnostics Division's sales were +3% at CER, -3% when reported in CHF, to CHF 6.7 billion, driven by growth in demand for immunodiagnostic and clinical chemistry products as well as pathology and molecular solutions. This growth more than offset the impact of healthcare pricing reforms in China.
sentences.text: Diagnostics adds a second engine, with sales of CHF 6.7 billion, up 3% at constant rates on immunodiagnostics, clinical chemistry, pathology and molecular demand, offsetting China pricing reforms.

The obesity programme offers optionality: CT-388 showed 22.5% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 48 weeks at the top dose in Phase II, and Roche started two Phase III trials for enicepatide plus a combination study with petrelintide.

sentences.quote: Roche reported positive phase III data for divarasib in KRAS G12C lung cancer and fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis.
sentences.text: Late-stage newsflow also includes positive Phase III data for divarasib in KRAS G12C lung cancer and fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis.
